cells.gaps: No startup act or strategy adopted is on record: in June 2025 the act had not been tabled in Cabinet. The Rwanda Innovation Fund and the investment code's angel incentives stand under no startup law.
cells.note: Housekeeping 76: Rwanda's Startup Act was still in drafting in June 2025 (RWA-002), so 2 holds. The investment code's start-up incentives (RWA-004) predate any startup law and are counted as other.
